facts.statement: Muriwaimanu was an extinct early penguin that lived in New Zealand during the Paleocene epoch.
facts.quote: Muriwaimanu is an extinct genus of early penguin from the Paleocene Waipara Greensand of New Zealand.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil of Muriwaimanu was discovered in 1980 near the Waipara River in Canterbury, New Zealand.
facts.quote: The holotype was discovered in 1980 within the Waipara Greensand near the Waipara River, in Canterbury, New Zealand

facts.statement: Mayr and colleagues re-examined the holotype in 2018 and established the new genus Muriwaimanu for the species M. tuatahi.
facts.quote: Mayr et al. (2018) re-examined the specimen and determined that it belonged to a separate genus, creating the species Muriwaimanu tuatahi.

facts.statement: A second partial specimen of Muriwaimanu was discovered by Leigh Love in 2017 within the Waipara Greensand.
facts.quote: A second specimen from the Waipara Greensand (CM 2018.124.4), consisting of a partial specimen preserved within two blocks of sandstone, was discovered by Leigh Love in 2017

facts.statement: Muriwaimanu possessed a long, narrow beak and paddle-shaped wings.
facts.quote: Muriwaimanu exhibited a long, narrow beak and paddle-shaped wings

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that Muriwaimanu may represent a transitional species leading to modern Antarctic penguins.
facts.quote: suggesting that Muriwaimanu may be a transition species for modern Antarctic penguins

facts.statement: Muriwaimanu is classified within the order Sphenisciformes.
Muriwaimanu lived between 61.66 and 56 million years ago, spanning the Selandian to Thanetian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Selandian to Thanetian (61.66 to 56 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Fossil evidence suggests Muriwaimanu kept its wings in a flexed position during downward strokes, unlike modern penguins.
rejected.quote: the fossilized remains also indicate it may have kept their wings in a flexed position during downward strokes, unlike modern penguins whose wings are kept extended
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'wings in a flexed position during downward strokes'
